blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Authorities are intensifying traffic enforcement along the Trans-Central Highway following reports of motorcycle riders allegedly engaging in illegal racing, excessive speeding and other reckless driving activities on the mountain road. The enforcement action followed the circulation of online videos showing motorcycle riders allegedly racing and engaging in other dangerous driving activities along the highway.
